description.zh: 本課程內容分二部分進行授課，第一個部份以小組進行校園建築進行實測後，繪製平、立、剖面圖，以加強學生團隊合作，並透過實際量測與繪製建築平、立、剖面圖，使學生感受實體與練習之關係；由於目前臺灣多以集合住宅建照申請居多，且住宅為空間尺度之根本；因此，第二個部份之課堂操作，依序為浴廁、臥室、廚房、餐廳、客廳單元等不同空間尺度練習後，聚焦於住宅平面圖之練習；接著，透過住宅平面圖之練習，衍伸至立面圖與剖面圖與透視圖練習。課程亦將藉由同學上述二個部分之練習，延續第一學期建築製圖基本常識、觀念與技法之傳授，以確實增進學生建築製圖能力。 本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。
description.en: This course will need the knowledge from the previous course Architectural Graphics (1) and apply them into graphics; The course have two parts, first part of the course will split the class into small groups ,students will first measuring the school buildings and than draw them into three-dimensional diagrams. Second, lecture the detail graphics of residential building such as the floor plan, bathroom, bedroom, kitchen etc. and more drawing practice on cross section graphics and elevation graphics. During the semester Introduction to graphics will enable the students ready for second semester. After this course the students will acquire the following aspects: 1). Advance knowledge in architectural design and engineering. 2). Practical skill in architectural design and structure. 3). Correct attitude in architectural professions moral. 4). Integrate theory an

notes: 建築一與創意一合開（限主修建築系選課）*

description.zh: 本課程主要在教導學生對西方(歐洲及西亞)認識歷史建築之演進過程與思考涵構，並使學生具備西方文化歷史與思想的相關知識，其主要授課內容如下：1.在範圍上--自古埃及、西亞、而收至古典建築、基督教建築、中世紀的大教堂時代以至文藝復興及17、18世紀的建築歷史。2.在思想上--自希臘的文化與哲學思想談起，以至各時代之政治、宗教與社會文明之演進，瞭解歷史涵構及其對建築的表現。3.在建築上─針對每一時期的建築表現，瞭解其構造方法、材料應用及相關細部特徵。
description.en: This course is mainly to teach students the evolution process and connotation of historical buildings in the West (Europe and West Asia), and to equip students with relevant knowledge of Western culture, history and thought. The main teaching contents are as follows: 1. In terms of scope-- From ancient Egypt, West Asia, and the collection to classical architecture, Christian architecture, medieval cathedral era, Renaissance and the architectural history of the 17th and 18th centuries. 2. In terms of ideology-from the Greek culture and philosophical thought, to the evolution of politics, religion and social civilization in various eras, understand the historical connotation and its expression on architecture. 3. In architecture—according to the architectural performance of each period, understand its construction method, material application and related detail features.

notes: 建築一與創意一合開（限主修建築系選課）

description.zh: 本課程之主要目的在於教授都市設計的基本分析理論與方法，除透過課堂案例的介紹與討論外，學生還將以分組方式進行觀察研究與運算分析。案例介紹與討論之重點在於認識影響都市空間環境品質的關鍵要素，而分組研究之目的則在於讓學生藉由各種現場觀察與數位分析工具的應用，進一步探索這些關鍵要素在都市空間形構過程的交互影響過程。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to key theoretical and methodological approaches in urban design. The main content will be delivered through a series of case study discussion and project-based research practice. In specific, the case study is to review and identify key factors shaping the physical environment of cities; while through collaborative research projects, students are expected to engage in a step-by-step process of on-site observation and computational analysis, examining how the factors are interacting with each other.

notes: 建都所與設計博合開

description.zh: 面臨我國高齡化社會的趨勢下，老人與環境的議題急待重視。在觀察老人與環境互動的過程中，需將老人的生活空間經驗置入於生活變遷、社會關係及文化脈絡的向度中來討論。本課程是綜合心理學、心理學、社會學、建築與都市規劃等多面向學科來探討老人的身心特性及老年生活環境之需求。
description.en: Facing a trend toward the aging society, the issue about the elderly and environment is supposed to be valued. In view of the process of the elderly and environment interaction , this research puts the living space experience of Taiwan elderly into the living transition, social relation and culture context for sector consideration. It is a complexity course integrated with Psychology, Physiology, Sociology, Architecture and Urban planning in order to study the characters of physiological and psychological of the elderly and the need of living environment.

notes: 日、職建都所與設計博合開 配合USR計畫

description.zh: 由於九零年代後，城市急速擴張與超越領域性(de-terrorization)的連結等新興狀態萌生，基礎設施(infrastructure)的定義逐漸開始難以精確認定，而身為城市興衰論述的經常主體，基礎設施自身的論述與再定義卻在空間學門中成為那缺落的一塊。基於此，本課程期望透過幾項特定學門角度，提供一個對於基礎設施為研究主題的論述框架，進而連結建築學門與相關空間學門間對於當代全球城市論述中之縫隙，能在跨學門田野研究中提出他種可能性(alternatives)。 本課程將以兩種方項進行基礎設施當代性的"實踐"; 部分課程內容將邀請德國杜賓根大學台灣研究中心，以空間社會學角度提供授課交流。另一部分將透過雙邊學生，以共同主題進行台北與德國城市的實際田野調查並以比較分析的方式進行合作討論。課程架構則以建築學與空間社會學為主軸剖析，分為五個部分:全球城市與多尺度論述，當代基礎設施與建築/地景對話，社會基礎設施的物質性與再生產，看不見的基礎設施與田野調查為總結。預計學生能透過不同學門角度的切入、於不同文化背景學生間合作討論、多種教學方式的引導，培養基礎辯證思考之能力並進一步對當代都市基礎設施的空間性研究之興趣。
description.en: In the contemporary word, especially in globalized cities, infrastructure is hard to define for many reasons and at some points infrastructure is also often invisible to its users.This class will therefore seek to rethink the subject of infrastructure from particular perspectives which frame the structure of this module. We then proposed a join-class with Taiwan study centre at University of T?bingen, Germany for wider debates and teaching possibilities as well. There will be two academic discourses-Architecture and sociology involved and formed into five sessions which can be seen in course syllabus. In so doing, it will focus on firstly by reading theory; secondly, by examining specific case studies that illustrates how these theories manifests themselves; and thirdly, by considering how these infrastructures may be changing the understanding of contemporary globalized cities and reproducing urban networks in different fields and countries.

name.zh: 當代城市中都市社會基礎設施再思
name.en: Rethinking urban social infrastructure in contemporary cities

notes: 建築四、建都所合開

description.zh: 臺灣建築史的發展大約可分成受到漢民族影響的傳統建築，以及日本和西方世界影響的近現代建築，本課程主要探究臺灣近現代建築發展的歷程。本課程係以時間為軸，將台灣近現代建築分為三個主題：(1) 臺灣近現代建築的背景、(2) 臺灣殖民時期、(3) 二次大戰之後的臺灣建築。
description.en: This course mainly discusses the development of modern Taiwanese architecture since the Japanese colonial period. The historical development of Taiwanese architecture could be divided into traditional Han architecture and modern architecture with Japanese and western influences. Based on the timeline, three themes will be introduced: (1) the background of Taiwanese modern architecture, (2) Taiwanese architecture during the colonial period, (3) Taiwanese architecture after the Second World War.

notes: 建築四、建都所合開

description.zh: 現代性源自於歐洲獨有的歷史文化與社會，在工業化、理性化和民主化的推波助瀾下綻放開來，促使人們從神話、威權和中心性解放出來，擺脫傳統社會的制約。透過現代性的反證精神和批判性概念，歐洲幾乎於整個二十世紀初開展出驚人的物質和人類意識的進程。而建築的生產與整個社會、經濟、政治和審美價值緊密相關的專業，又是如何以自身作為對於現代性的批判?本課程將以辨明現代性概念為主軸，透過阿道夫·魯斯(Adolf Loos)、西格弗里德·吉迪恩(Sigfried Giedion)、華特·班雅明(Walter Benjamin)、恩斯特·布洛赫(Ernst Bloch)、和威尼斯學派(Venice School)的論說作為理解現代性含混而艱澀的觀念，並藉由藝術和建築作品的探索，作為對於現代性的批判與理念的參照，包括前衛派藝術對於建築的衝擊、新巴比倫的城市景觀社會反論、建築的擬仿和批判等等。
description.en: The term “Modernity” originated from the unique European history, culture, and societal condition, bloomed with the development of industrialization, rationalization and democratization. That have inspired human to liberate from mythology, authority and centrality, and get rid of the constraints of traditional society. With the antithesis and critical concepts of modernity, Europe has carried out an amazing progress of material and human consciousness almost throughout the twentieth century. How does architecture as a profession closely related to the entire society, economy, politics, and aesthetic approach, in the process of production implemented itself as a critique of modernity?In the beginning of the class, it would be most important to identify the concepts of Modernity. The discourses of Adolf Loos, Sigfried Giedion, Walter Benjamin, Ernst Bloch, and the Venetian School help to clarify the vague and difficult concepts of modernity. description.zh: 本課程從建築物構築方法和材料特性出發，介紹構法的歷史以及創新應用。內容包括現行工法的運用，以及先進工法的突破。藉由課程引導和案例介紹，培養學生構法知識與應用能力，提升學理與實務上的知能。
description.en: This course starts from building construction methods, introduces the technical history, innovative applications of construction methods. The content includes the application of current construction methods, as well as the breakthrough of advanced construction. Through course guidance and case study, students will cultivate their knowledge of construction method, and enhance their ability in academic theory and practice.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

notes: *體適能G

description.zh: 本課程介紹程式設計的觀念與方法，內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念。有關物件導向程式設計與系統分析之概念亦將於程式語法純熟後予以介紹。
description.en: This course investigates the principles, languages and environments, and elementary design methods for programming design. The content focuses on logic design and training programming capability. Some concepts such as program structure, debugging, portability and software engineering are considered as well. Some topics about object-oriented programming language and system analysis are also addressed after students familiar with the programming language.

notes: 計中教室

description.zh: 當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂精實導向的企業。
description.en: Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called lean-oriented enterprise.

interdisciplinary: 智慧製造管理微學程
notes: 工管三甲乙丙合開,20/15人

description.zh: 使電腦系統具有解決問題的能力、智慧的表現及儲存的型態、理解及辨識的能力、及視覺、聽覺、觸覺及表達的能力、並有學習、認知、分析理解等能力。
description.en: Made computer the power of problem solving, intelligent behavior and storage type, comprehension and distinguish abilities. The abilities of vision, hearing, touching, learning, identifying, analyzing are also the target of the course.

interdisciplinary: 工程數位科技與人工智慧微學程
notes: IMBA&IMFI&工管所&管理博班&資財所

description.zh: 本課程在於協助同學了解數位轉型的浪潮趨勢，以及適應新科技所改變的商業模式。課程將介紹創新的商業模式例如共享經濟、金融科技、線上至離線、使用者生成內容等平台模式應用。每個模式將會連結到實務中企業個案，以協助同學進一步深入了解與分析創新的模式概念。本課程將涵蓋數位轉型與創新模式的基本概念，以數位轉型與科技適應角度，透過實務案例來了解創新商業模式。
description.en: This course aims to help students understand the trend of digital transformation and technology adaption in business models. The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

name.zh: 數位轉型與創新商業模式
name.en: Digital Transformation and Innovative Business Models

notes: IMBA&IMFI&經管所&資財所

description.zh: 本課程旨在幫助學生建立足夠的知識與技能在企業研究方法上。課程內容主要分為兩部分， 第一部分將首先介紹論文架構開始，緊接著介紹如何撰寫緒論、文獻探討、研究方法、資料收集、結果分析、討論、結論及參考文獻，配合課程中的實際案例討論，指導學生應注意的論文格式與規範。本課程的第二部分則在介紹目前企業研究上常用的各種數量方法，各種數量方法的原理及其應用的領域將以實際案例解釋說明，透過上課解說演練、討論、作業、報告等方式使學生熟悉各種研究方法。主要教授的研究方法包括層級分析法、網路程序分析、TOPSIS、VIKOR、灰關聯法、決策實驗分析法、模糊理論、約略集合及基本多變量分析。所教授的各種的研究方法將以Excel進行分析與計算演練，本課程學習結束後，學生應當能具備足夠的能力使用各種研究方法於企業問題解決。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help students build up the knowledge/skills in business research methods. The content of the course can be divided by two major parts. The first part will begin from the introduction of thesis structure, followed by how to write the introduction, literature review, methodology, data collection, result analysis, discussion, remarking and reference. The format of thesis will also be illustrated by some class examples. The second part of the class will begin from the introduction of different quantity methods commonly used in business research methods today. The categories of research methods and their applicable problems are then presented using real-world case studies. Students can learn different decision-making tools through lectures, discussion, assignment, term-projects and in class practices. The main methods include AHP, ANP, TOPSIS, VIKOR, DEMATEL, Gray Relation Methods, Fuzzy Set Theory, Rough Set Theory and some basic multivariate analysis.

notes: IMBA&IMFI&工管所&管理博班,Computer Room

description.zh: 課程大綱規劃主要依據上述的四部份分別進行授課，包含固態氧化物燃料電池之原理應用及檢測、潔淨能源技術、變頻式高效率交流液體技術與生質能及敏化染料太陽能技術，分別敘述如下：1.潔淨能源技術能源概論，非再生能源與再生能源的利用能源的有效變換，未來能源的 發展形態有效能源之解析與評估，能源效率之管理。本課程主要是探討燃料電池的製程技術與發展。a. 燃料電池製程技術介紹(Introduction)b. 電池效率與開路電壓(Efficiency and Open Circuit Voltage)c. 操作燃料與電壓(Operational Fuel and Voltage)d. 中子交換薄膜燃料電池(Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells)e. 鹼性電解質燃料電池(Alkaline Electrolyte Fuel Cells)f. 甲烷燃料電池(Direct Methanol Fuel Cells)g. 中溫與高溫燃料電池(Medium and High Temperature Fuel Cells)h. 燃料電池之燃料添加(Fuelling Fuel Cells)i. 壓縮機、透平機、葉扇與?浦(Compressors, Turbines, Ejectors, Fans, Blowers, and Pumps)j. 燃料電池之動力輸送(Delivering Fuel Cell Power)k. 燃料電池之系統分析(Fuel Cell Systems Analyzed)
description.en: This course clean energy covers the fundamentals and applications of fuel cell, solar cell and biomass energy. The fundamentals are introductory of the energy source principle and transfer mechanism of fuel cell, solar cell and biomass energy. The design and production technologies of the clean energy are introduced and discussed. The examples or other topics of clean energy applications and procedures as well as specifications of the testing are usually regardant in this introductory course.

notes: 機電所、機械外生和能源車輛專班合開/需有白板教室/限

description.zh: 智慧製造意旨透過資通訊及數位技術（例如數位控制、智慧機器人、自動光學檢測、雲端運算、人工智慧與物聯網等）的輔助，讓生產系統更具智慧，減少生產成本、提升產品品質與增加客戶滿意。本課程透過問題導向學習(PBL)方法，引導學生學習關於智慧製造之核心技術。
description.en: English description：The objective of smart manufacturing is to reduce manufacturing cost using information and communication technology, including digital control, industrial Robotics, automated inspection, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and internet of thing (IOT). This course provides introduction of smart manufacturing and hands on practice about collaborative robot (Cobot) and manufacturing execution system (MES) operation under the framework of problem-based learning (PBL) model.

name.en: Problem Based Learning, special topics in Smart Manufacturing

notes: 工管三乙丙和工管所合開

This course provides introduction of smart manufacturing and hands on practice about collaborative robot (Cobot) and manufacturing execution system (MES) operation under the framework of problem-based learning (PBL) model.

name.en: Problem Based Learning, special topics in Smart Manufacturing

notes: 學25碩10合開

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於進化計算方法、模擬退火法、遺傳演算法、蟻群優化法和粒子群優化等啟發式演算法之介紹，以及演算法於經典最佳化問題之應用，並以管理科學之實務案例討論演算法之應用。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction to heuristic and metaheuristic algorithms, including Evolutionary Computation, Simulated Annealing (SA), Genetic Algorithm (GA), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and their application in well-known optimization problems. Case studies for a variety of problems will also be discussed.

notes: 工管所和管理博班合開

description.zh: 隨著新冠肺炎的疫情，遠距的商機迅速崛起。在後疫情時代，人們的行為模式改變了，接受訊息的渠道幾乎都轉移到網路上，而商業行為自然也必須更新行銷手段，於是數位行銷（ Digital Marketing ）應勢而生。電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，經營數位行銷的需求，已經是每個公司所必需的。從新產品的開發、行銷、到售後服務均受影響。數位化的網路電子商務已經成為未來商業發展的主流。因此，如何經營數位行銷已是現代企業具有競爭力重要課題。
description.en: After the Cov-19, digital marketing is the conducting of business on the internet, not only buying and selling but also servicing customers and collaborating with business partners. This course will introduce the digital marketing by the way of concept, theory and case study. This course will study how to develope the business on the internet.

notes: 工管四甲乙丙、工管所和管理博合開,計中教室

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在學習隨機最佳化方法在生產與服務系統的理論與應用，以解決不確定環境下的實務問題。課程內容包括：(1)隨機最佳化基本概念與應用、(2)二階段隨機規劃模型、(3)多階段隨機規劃模型、(4)隨機規劃演算法、(5)穩健最佳化模型、(6)模擬最佳化演算法、(7)強化學習演算法、(8)隨機最佳化應用論文導讀。
description.en: This course will introduce the stochastic optimization theory and learn its application on production and service systems under uncertainties. The topics addressed in this course include: (1) Basic concept and application of stochastic optimization, (2) Two-stage stochastic programming model, (3) Multi-stage stochastic model, (4) Stochastic programming algorithms, (5) Robust optimization model, (6) Simulation optimization algorithms, (7) Reinforcement learning algorithms, (8) Paper readings on stochastic optimization.

notes: 工管所和管理博班合開

description.zh: 本課程將介紹計算智慧的相關知識、技術與其優點，旨在教授學生如何運用計算智慧技術解決實際問題。課程目標有二：(1)相關的計算智慧技術與其運作原理，包含：遺傳演算法、多目標遺傳演算法等；(2)相關的應用案例討論。透過此課程，學生將可套用計算智慧技術於各種最佳化問題。
description.en: This course will introduce related knowledge, techniques and merits of computational intelligence for providing useful ways for students to solve the real application problems. The goals of this course include two parts: (1) related computational intelligence techniques and how it work, including genetic algorithms, multi-objective genetic algorithm, etc; (2) related applications and discussions. Through this course, students can learn how to apply computational intelligence on different optimization problems.

notes: 科研243

description.zh: 隨著新冠肺炎的疫情，遠距的商機迅速崛起。在後疫情時代，人們的行為模式改變了，接受訊息的渠道幾乎都轉移到網路上，而商業行為自然也必須更新行銷手段，於是數位行銷（ Digital Marketing ）應勢而生。電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，經營數位行銷的需求，已經是每個公司所必需的。從新產品的開發、行銷、到售後服務均受影響。數位化的網路電子商務已經成為未來商業發展的主流。因此，如何經營數位行銷已是現代企業具有競爭力重要課題。

This course will introduce the digital marketing by the way of concept, theory and case study. This course will study how to develope the business on the internet.

Electrostatic Field Ⅲ：Genernal Methods for Solving Laplace's and Poisson's Equations4. Relativity I：The Basic Concepts5. Relativity II：The Electric and Magnetic Field of Moving Electric Charges6. description.zh: 本課程專注在創業管理的基礎以及前瞻面向，以理論、實務、產業分析以及個案討論做為課程內容。創業課程在全球視野上涵蓋了科技性以及廣泛性的討論，其許多論點對於策略管理亦有重要的意涵。本課程將提供學生務實的方法引導未來創業所需的基礎以及營運新創事業的必要認知。期盼本課程中學生可以進行創業思考，了解創意與創業的執行方法，進而培育未來成功的創業家。
description.en: This course focuses on the fundamental and advanced aspects of management of start-up with theories, practices, industry analyses, and case studies. It is consciously designed with a technological and global outlook since this orientation in many ways highlights the significant emerging trends in strategic management. The course is intended to provide the students with a pragmatic approach that will guide the formulation and implementation of start up a high-tech business. Students are expected to think and behave with creativity and execution capability as successful entrepreneurs after the trainings from this course.

notes: IMBA&IMFI

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際電機技術(元件、電路、方法)之專利申請案，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論專利申請後的答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: In this course, we will focus on the practice of the patent application in electrical engineering technology. Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in this class.

name.en: Practice in electrical engineering technology patent application

notes: 電機四甲乙丙、智財所合開

description.zh: 廣告策略與企畫為廣告之進階課程,學生需結合行銷,廣告,創意,消費者心理及行為等領域之知識,並具備優秀之企畫能力,為所指定之企業,產品或理念規畫完整之整合行銷傳播企畫案。
description.en: nternational Advertising and Media Strategy takes a market-oriented approach to the total campaign. The course interrelates planning, creative and technical skills with emphasis on problem-solving and marketing communications.

interdisciplinary: 國際領導力微學程

description.zh: 本課程將介紹基於神經網路的深度學習技術及其在商情預測上之應用， 主要內容包括：（1）深度學習和神經網路的基本概念和演算法；（2）深度學習的主流結構、啟動函數及正則化技術；（3）電腦視覺與自然語言處理技術應用案例；（4）深度學習主流結構的商情預測應用。通過課程的學習，同學們可瞭解神經網路基本概念；掌握深度學習中主要網路結構的基本概念和相關演算法；瞭解具體應用領域的背景知識；應用相關深度學習技術於商情預測。
description.en: This course will give a full picture of deep learning techniques and its application in business forecasting. Content includes: (1) basic concepts and algorithms of deep learning and neural networks; (2) popular network structures, activation functions, and regularization techniques; (3) principle and applications of computer vision and natural language processing. (4) applications of popular network structures in business forecasting. By learning this course, students will consolidate the basic concepts of neural networks; master the basic concepts and related algorithms of the main network structure in deep learning; understand the background knowledge of deep learning techniques with specific application fields; and understanding how to apply the main network structure in business forecasting.

interdisciplinary:
人工智慧科技學程
人工智慧與深度學習微學程

description.zh: 本課程將從傳播理論與社會互動探討互動性與消費者行為相關理論，並分析由互動性發展出的虛擬經驗，以及分析廠商藉由與顧客互動所產生的顧客知識要如何回應與管理，藉以建立良好的顧客關係。課程主要以個案討論方式進行。
description.en: The topics of this course include social media, consumer behavior, interactivity, and virtual experience, virtual community, quality of interactivity, interactive technology, customer service on the Internet, levels of customer relationship, transaction cost theory, Internet business model, interactive technology and customer and channel relationship.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生創新服務設計能力，融合服務設計觀點完成服務藍圖。其中著重於智慧聯網應用場域所可能涵蓋的各類產品及其服務設計之學習與實作達成本課程之學習目標。課程中透過智慧聯網科技趨勢等智慧聯網服務與應用內涵、智慧化情境發想、關係人洞察、產品服務藍圖、可行性分析、產品概念設計、營運計畫書規劃等系統化流程與方法，搭配國內外指標案例解析及實務案例，使學生瞭解創新智慧化服務設計的內涵，具備規劃服務設計的能力。
description.en: This course is designed to develop students' innovative service design capabilities and integrate service design perspectives to complete the service blueprint. It focuses on the learning and implementation of the various products and service designs that may be covered by the Smart Connected Application Domain to achieve the learning objectives of this course.In the course, through the networked services such as smart networking technology trends and application connotation, intelligent situational thinking, relationship insight, product service blueprint, feasibility analysis, product concept design, operational plan planning and other systematic processes and methods, with Domestic and international indicators case analysis and practical cases enable students to understand the connotation of innovative and intelligent service design and have the ability to plan service design.

name.en: The Special Topics on Innovation and Service Design

description.zh: 本科目旨在探討人們的選擇行為，亦即如何利用有限的資源，以滿足人類無限的慾望。個體經濟學著眼於價格機能之方析，範圍涵蓋：消費者行為、廠商理論、各種市場的結構分析、以及公共部門的決策。
description.en: Economics explores choice behavior of human beings. Especially, it concerns how people make choice in order to satisfy their unlimited desire under limited resources. Microeconomics focuses on the analysis of price mechanism which involves consumer behavior, firms' decision making, structure of various markets, and public sector.

notes: 留浩洋

description.zh: 介紹審計準則與查核報告、職業道德、專業責任的保持：查核人員的監管和法律責任、審計證據、審計業務承接、內部控制、資訊科技環境下的審計、審計抽樣的應、查核工作底稿、收入循環、採購支出及付款循環等。 本課程參考最新國際準則公報並依照現行教學及考試方向調整原有架構之外，更針對鑑識審計、公司治理、審計業務承接、查帳和客戶之間的關係、風險評估以及資訊科技環境下的審計等做了更多的著墨，而近更動之審計公報也於本版一併進行更新，以求更符合趨勢。
description.en: Introduction auditing standards and audit report, maintaining professional ethics, professional responsibility: the regulatory and legal responsibility to check personnel, audit evidence, audit business undertaking, internal control, information technology audit environment, audit sampling should be to check the working papers, income circulation, procurement spending and payment cycle and so on. The course reference to the latest international standards and adjust the original architecture communique teaching and examination in accordance with current direction, it is more for the forensic audit, corporate governance, auditing business undertaking, under the audit and the relationship between the customer, risk assessment and information technology environment audit done more inked, and audit bulletin of recent changes in this edition also be updated in order to be more consistent with the trend.

description.zh: 電子商務的應用與發展已對企業經營與生活方式造成相當大的衝擊，在網路發展先驅與先行導入區域已逐漸將網路應用納入企業日常運作以及居家生活中的一部份。這些應用無論我們從媒體(media)功能、通路(channel)功能來區分，或是從對象來分為B2B、B2C、C2C以及企業內部之應用，其企業經營的方式與傳統模式有許多的不同，因而也衍生許多有趣、重要課題。
description.en: Introduction to Electronic Commerce (E-commerce)- information evolution- information network, telecommunication and business - information society (4C)‥ Discussion of business to business operations (Extranet)‥ Discussion of business to consumer services (Internet) and internet marketing ‥ Discussion of organization management and control (Intranet)‥ Discussion of e-commerce systems and technology support

notes: 經管三、四和經管所合開

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.en: This course includes following sections: 1.The Analysis of global logistics environment; 2. Global logistics business model 3.The model of performance evaluation for global logistics; 4.Global logistics operation model; 5.4PL in global logistics environment; 6.Other issues related global logistics, like logistic flow and customer; 7.Case study. 8. The future trend of R.O.C. global logistics management.

description.zh: 本課程利用要徑法教導學生管理一項專案有關時間及成本的估計，進度表，預算編列等技巧，及其它監督控制一項專案進行之措施。專案經理在一家公司組織內的地位和角色亦將加以討論。課程內容包含：（1）專案的定義和辨認，（2）專案可行性研究和選擇條件，（3）專案進度表編排，（4）專案之預算與成本控制，（5）限制性資源之編排與調配，（6）專案評核與檢討技巧。
description.en: This course introduces the technique of Critical Path Method (CPM) to manage a project in terms of time / cost estimation, scheduling, budgeting, and other control / monitoring measures on the performance of a project. The role of project manager in an organization will also be discussed. Topics to be covered are: (1) Concept and identification of a project, (2) Project feasibility study and selection criteria, (3) Project scheduling, (4) Budgeting and cost control, (5) Constrained resource scheduling and leveling, and (6) Project evaluation and review technique.

notes: 經管三、四合開，2週【停開】

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討企業面對數位轉型衝擊下，其商業模式勢必要有所調整。其中商業模式在數位化下如何規劃與運作，以及其中如何將數據運用與融入營運機制是其重要課題。因此，課程中除了基本數位商業模式與數據驅動營運之基礎概念與其對應之理論講授外之外，為增進學生對其實務應用了解，相關之產業個案亦作探討。
description.en: This course aims to explore the need for adjustments in the business model of enterprises facing the impact of digital transformation. Among them, how to plan and operate the business model under digitalization, and how to use and integrate data into the operating mechanism is an important topic. Therefore, in addition to basic digital business models and basic concepts of tree-residential-driven operations and their corresponding theoretical lectures, the course also explores industrial cases in order to enhance students’ understanding of practical applications.

Students will learn how to do patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and reply office action responses. In addition, the practical aspects of international patent application are presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies will be also discussed in class.

description.zh: 利用光纖來製造雷射與光放大器已經廣泛的應用在各領域，由於光纖具有小的纖核，且光在此介質傳播時，通常具有相當長的傳播距離，此外利用各種鎖模技術所產生的短脈衝或是藉由光放大器，使得在光纖中傳播的光具有相當高的功率或是峰值功率，因此許多非線性光學的現象在光纖中被產生，近來更種新穎的光纖包括利用微結構光纖或稱為光子晶體光纖被廣泛的應用，使得光纖所產生非線性效應更為顯著，本課程將介紹在光纖中各種非線性光學現象產生的原理與其應用。
description.en: Fiber laser and amplifier have been widely used in various fields. Due to its small core and relative long propagation length of fiber and relative large power and peak power light source is used, that is generated from mode-locked technique and amplifier, various nonlinear optical phenomena can be observed through propagation of the fiber. Recently, many novel optical fibers including the microstructured fiber or termed photonic crystal fiber are widely used to cause the advance of the generated nonlinear phenomena. In this course, it will introduce the principle of the generated nonlinear effects and its applications.

description.zh: 歷史想像讓人可以掙脫現實世界，縱橫遨遊於歷史之海。本課程學習相關歷史，培養學生利用本地文化為素材，學習文化相關創作、鑑賞的基礎知識。現代人對影像敏銳度很高，藉由「影視史學」的圖像與影像的引領，使修課同學瞭解各地不同的歷史發展、生活樣貌與思考模式。以活潑的史實，引領同學多面向的思考，理解多元價值的真諦。
description.en: Historical imagination can release us from the bonds and limits of reality bygiving us various perspectives of ideas, values and patterns of life over times. Now through the media of film, a powerful recorder of life and events, this course intends to equip students with an ability to appreciate a film as a cultural and historical text so as to seek the presence of historical phenomena and sociological significance. Vivid cases of film evidence will be presented to inspire students to interpret and reevaluate the great historical issues of the times so that they can understand the true essence of many values and foster the capacity of multi-dimensional thinking.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters. The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis. After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 當代飾品設計及製作是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的設計性課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生基礎金工珠寶的製作能力並進行應用。課程旨在結合金屬工藝與多元媒材的當代趨勢，引導學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: This course will use a combination of lectures, demonstrations, and practical experiences to educate the student in the basic skills required to work as a member of jewelry design discipline. This class will also be an introduction to the multiple media of design. Contemporary Jewelry Design will provide an overview of the professional world of Jewelry design through a practical exhibition.

notes: 限25人

description.zh: 本課程介紹科技論文寫作與報告，課程內容包括科技論文寫作元素介紹(摘要、介紹、方法、結果、討論、結論)與撰寫方式，文獻搜尋與整理，報告與發表注意事項，以利環境所碩博士生應用於未來論文撰寫與成果發表。
description.en: This class focuses on the Introduction of major elements in technical writing, including abstract, introduction, research methods, results, discussion, and conclusion. Writing grammar, style, and methods to perform literature search and review are also introduced. The main aim of this course is enhancing the ability of graduate students in future thesis writing and research publication.

notes: 【停開】

description.zh: 先修課程：統計學基礎統計介紹、一因子、二因子、多因子實驗、完全隨機化法、隨機化區集法、拉丁方格法、及直交表、田口式品質工程。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide students with methods of promoting experimental efficiency. It may include introduction to basic statistical concepts, one-factor, two-factor, multi-factor experiments, completely randomized design, randomized block design, Latin square, and orthogonal array, Taguchi technique for quality engineering.

notes: 機電所和製科所合開/限20人

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在探討及分析各種先進通訊技術，相關領域包括新世代無線通訊、電信網路、多媒體訊號處理等
description.en: This course aims to explore and analyze various advanced communication technologies related to areas of new generation wireless .communications, telecommunication networks, and multimedia signal processing, and so on.

name.en: Advanced special topics on communication engineering

notes: ◎電機所和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 本課程包含: 偏極光學、干涉光學及傅氏光學。
description.en: The course is includes: polarization optics， interference optics and Fourier optics

interdisciplinary:
電資_第二專長【光電系_光電半導體】
電資_第二專長【光電系_光通訊】

電資_第二專長【光電系_先進光學科技】

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。 1.簡介 2.數位影像處理基礎 3.影像的轉換 4.影像的增強 5.影像的復原 6.影像的壓縮 7.影像的分割 8.影像的表達及描述 9.醫學影像的處理和應用 10.利用雷射光做3D電腦視覺

notes: ◎ Digital Image Processin

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度，切入擴增實境產業的各種可能性。從教育應用、設計工具以及擴增實境遊戲設計、擴增實境互動式動畫製作等，進行探討。
description.en: The main objective of the program, is taking from the application and design perspective, cut into the possibilities of virtual reality industry. Exploring from the educational applications, design tools and virtual reality games, to virtual reality interactive animation, etc.

interdisciplinary: 設計_第二專長【互動系_虛擬實境與擴增實境應用與設計】
notes: 限本系生&第二專長(A)修,上限40人

description.zh: 本課程將討論材料凝固熱力學、材料凝固動力學、平衡及非平衡狀態下材料的凝固現象與凝固界面之溶質濃度分佈情形。課程最後會介紹凝固學在工業界的應用實例：單晶成長與鑄造工程。
description.en: This lecture will first discuss the Thermodynamics and Dynamics for Solidification in Materials under equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. Second, we will discuss the Solidification behavior and solutes distribution at the interface between solid and liquid. Finally, we will briefly introduce the applications of Solidification in industry cases: Single Crystal Growth and Casting engineering.

notes: 材資三四乙合開

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

notes: 上限24人◎B(僅限英文系學生修讀)

description.zh: 本課程欲讓應用英文系學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

name.zh: 全球議題與趨勢討論(二)
name.en: Discussions on Global Issues and Trends II

interdisciplinary: 國際領導力微學程
notes: 上限25人大二多元英文(僅限英文系學生修讀)

description.zh: 你熱愛文學嗎?你對社會及社會影響世界的方式好不好奇?你想不想探索社會政治事件表面背後的意涵?你喜不喜愛語言? 你是否會對許多故事的力量和神奇之處著迷?如果你的答案是否定的，透過這門課程，你會發現文學提供了既有價值又發人深省的社會觀點。反之，如果你熱愛文學，並且早已深受文學語言的吸引，你在這門課程裡將可從文學間接獲取豐富的生活經驗，進而學會如何理解世界。具體而言，藉由探索文學和社會的互動關係，透過研究社會如何促成文學的產生、賦之予脈絡，並加以型塑，以及文學如何反映、影響、塑造、及改變社會，你將會瞭解文學及語言的力量，更重要的是能在所處之世界裡變得安然自在。我們可能研讀的作品包括，但不限於，Things Fall Apart, Anthills of the Savannah, Uncle Tom’s Cabin, 1984, Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close等書。
description.en: Do you have a passion for literature? Are you curious about society and the way it influences the world around us? Would you like to explore the facade of sociopolitical events? Do you love language and are you fascinated by the power and magic of stories? If not, you will nevertheless learn in this course that literature provides a valuable and inspiring perspective on society. On the other hand, if you have already had a strong passion for literature and if you are already fascinated by literary language, you will learn in this course how to make sense of your world by enriching your vicarious experiences of it through literature. Specifically, by exploring the interaction between literature and society, by studying not only how society gives rise to, contextualizes, and molds literature, but also how literature mirrors, influences, shapes, and changes society, you will realize the power of literature and language and, more importantly, become at home in the world. The texts we will

notes: 上限25人大二多元英文(僅限英文系學生修讀)

description.zh: 基於學生畢業後的生涯發展，本課程目標旨在提供學生清楚認知未來的生涯發展，進而規劃自己的進路。針對設計學生畢業後的發展可以從學術界與實務界兩方面考量，學術界以直升研究所或工作後再修讀在職專班，而實務界則以可從事的相關職場做介紹與分析各行業的特色與前途，可擔任的職務名稱包括：互動設計師、互動程式設計師、使用者介面設計師、互動廣告企劃等，以供學生參考。
description.en: Based on the personal career development, the course aims to provide a clearly scope and knowledge of future career development. This career can be analyzed in two categories, one is academic field that provide the master program and in-job training program; the another is practical field which concerns about more related design job, such as interaction designer, interactive programmer, user interface designer and interactive advertisement planner. This course not only introduces the design-related job, but also analyzes their characteristics and future development route.

notes: 請排六教526,修課限30人

description.zh: 本課程的主要目的在學習物流管理的基本觀念與應用。課程內容包括：(1) 物流管理基本概念、(2)物流系統設計、(3)物流資訊科技、(4)物流運輸作業、(5)存貨管理、(6) 倉儲作業、(7)配送作業、(8)物流委外管理、(9)全球物流管理、(10)永續物流管理。
description.en: This course will introduce basic concept and application of logistics management. The topics addressed in this course include: (1) Basic concept and application of logistics management, (2) Logistics system and network design, (3) Logistics information technology, (4) Transportation management, (5) Inventory management, (6) Warehouse management, (7) Distribution management, (8) Logistics outsourcing management, (9) Global logistics management, (10) Sustainable logistics management.

notes: 甲乙丙合開 陳正中全英文

description.zh: 本課程提供理工學者撰寫科技論文之英文寫作技巧與指導，內容包括：扼要複習英文文法，詳細說明撰寫英文研究報告或論文時常犯的錯誤，深入討論標準英文寫作風格與修辭原則，提供簡易而有效的實作原則以提昇科技論文的可讀性。
description.en: This course develops a curriculum providing students with an English writing skill and direction focused on technical essays, including the followings :1. Concise review of English grammars2. Frequent writing mistakes of essays or reports3. Deep discussion concerning standard English writing style and rhetoric principles4. Offering simple and practical writing principles to increase the readability of technology essays.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 限21人

description.zh: 分子生物學主要藉由分子的方法來探討細胞的生成、組成、功能及相互間之作用。因此此課程會含概以下四大部分：1. 細胞之簡介2. 分子基因學3. 細胞之內部組成4. 細胞間之生長，交互作用之影響
description.en: The course is designed to teach upper level graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specificMolecular Biology is chiefly concentrated with eucaryotic cells and its title reflects the prime importance of the insights that have come from the molecular approach. This course will cover the following four different parts.1. Introduction to the cell2. Molecular genetics3. Internal organization of the cell4. Cells in their social context.

notes: 分子四和高分所合開

description.zh: 蛋白質與醣類科學課程是為進階研究所學生所設計的。這堂課的目標是在教導學生蛋白質科學和醣類科學最近的發展，以具體應用在醫療和生物科技產業為例子。學生必需要先修以下的課程： 一般有機化學， 生化， 蛋白質結構和醣質科學基礎科學。學生將預計學習蛋白質與醣類之結構， 蛋白質與醣類之生物合成，相關之具生物活性之醫療和生物科技蛋白質和多醣類。
description.en: The course is designed to teach upper level graduate students about the recent advances in protein science and glycobiology with specific application in medical and biotechnological industries. The prerequisite classes for this course are: general organic chemistry, biochemistry, protein structure and glycobiology. Students are expected to learn the structure, biosynthesis, chemistry and cell biology in related to bioactive protein and glycconjugates.

notes: 分子四和高分所合開

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。工程最佳化方法導論、線性規劃法、非線性規劃法、多目標函數最佳化、近代數學規劃法介紹、精密機電元件與系統之最佳設計。
description.en: Engineering Optimization Concepts, Linear Programming Methods, Nonlinear Programming Methods, Multi-objective Optimization, Introduction to Modern Mathematical Programming Techniques, and Optimum Design of Precision Machine Components and Systems.

notes: 機電所和機械自動化外生班合開,限50人/(三)ABC

description.zh: 本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括輔G熱力學?高分子的微結構及定性。輔G熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin理論、Flory-Krigbaum理論、相分離、θ-溫度、滲透壓、GPC測分子量、高分子膠體。?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en: The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

description.zh: 1.光纖感測介紹，2.光纖感測元件，3.光纖感測系統，4.光纖感測多工技術，5.光纖雷射感測系統，6.長距離光纖感測系統，7.大範圍多點光纖感測系統，8.光纖感測網路。
description.en: 1. Introduction to fiber optic sensor, 2. Fiber sensor devices, 3. Fiber sensor systems, 4. Fiber sensor multiplexing techniques, 5. Fiber-laser-based sensor systems, 6. Long-distance fiber sensor systems, 7. Large-scale multipoint fiber sensor systems, 8. Fiber sensor networks.

interdisciplinary: 智慧感測科技微學程

description.zh: X光已經成為材料結構鑑定上一項很有用的技術。這門課將介紹如何應用X光粉末繞射與吸收光譜於材料結構鑑定，以及數據分析。
description.en: X-ray has become a powerful technique on the characterization of material structures. The course will teach how to apply the x-ray diffraction and absorption on structural characterization and even analysis.

name.zh: X光在材料分析上的應用

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc. It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc.　Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

interdisciplinary: 工程_第二專長【分子系_纖維材料與紡織科技】
notes: 新老師

description.zh: 講授土木工程領域之相關災害的種類、特性、影響，如地震、洪泛、坡地災害、土石流、施工災害、環境污染等。探討其災害消減及預防規劃，並藉由風險管理的觀念介紹緊急應變計畫的準則。
description.en: This course introduces the types, characteristics andinfluences of civil engineering related disasters or hazards, such as earthquakes, floods, solpe failures, debris flows, and construction incidents. The hazard mitigation and precaution will also be discussed in class. By the concepts of risk management, the principle of emergency response plan will be introduced.

name.en: Introduction of Disaster Prevention and Civil Engineering

interdisciplinary:
生態工法與土木環境學程
房屋結構安全性能評估微學程

description.zh: 本門課藉由濕空氣線圖討論空氣調節之過程，分析人體舒適與空氣品質之需求，及各種空調設備系統之設計。本門課在空調負荷計算原理與方法涵蓋輻射熱、熱傳導及熱儲存效應等之分析，系統設計包括送風與送水系統之計算與設計，及室內送風分佈之理論與設計。
description.en: Air-conditioning processes are discussed by using psychrometric charts. Thermal comfort and indoor air quality requirements are presented. Design of air-conditioning equipment and systems are introduced. Air-conditioning load analysis includes radiation, transfer, and heat storage effects. System design includes design and calculation air and water moving systems. Air distribution principles and design are also covered.
